title: Who could be JPMorgan's next CEO? Two executives emerge as frontrunners to succeed Jamie Dimon
summary: For now, Dimon remains firmly in charge. But with Lake exiting and two executives elevated to co-president status, the race to eventually lead the world's most valuable bank has entered a new phase.
